email_note: Deep search per PIPELINE.md Fase 1 punto 7, all exhausted: (1) Instagram web_profile_info API (x-ig-app-id header) for nailz.by_ash returned HTTP 404 on every attempt (2 curl attempts with different UAs plus 1 WebFetch attempt returned HTTP 429) so business_email could not be read from IG directly; (2) Booksy's live JSON-LD for this business has no email field; (3) Booksy's internal __NUXT_DATA__ payload (devalue-format JSON) was fetched and parsed programmatically in Python and searched for '@' across the whole payload: no business email present, only Booksy's own generic help.us@booksy.com; (4) Facebook page (facebook.com/people/Nailz-By-Ash/100093038894382/, found via web search) returned a login-walled page with no accessible About/email; (5) a Linktree at linktr.ee/_nailz_by_ash_ was opened (per task brief hint) but its Instagram link points to a DIFFERENT handle (@_nailz_by_ash_, underscores, not the salon's @nailz.by_ash with a dot) and the page is a generic affiliate-marketing linktree (Fabletics, Headspace, Talkspace, Babbel, etc) plus a link to nailz-by-ash-2001.square.site, an e-commerce shop selling premade/custom press-on nail sets shipped by mail, not the Pompano Beach appointment salon. That square.site page's HTML does contain a contact address, nailzbyash2001@gmail.com, but given the mismatched Instagram handle and the different business model (e-commerce press-on nails vs. in-person Booksy salon), this could not be confirmed as the same 'Ashley' or the same business with the deep search available, so it is recorded here only as an unverified lead and was NOT used anywhere on the live site or in the outreach draft. Bottom line: no confirmed public email for the Booksy salon business itself.

instagram.note: Confirmed as the business's own Instagram via Booksy's JSON-LD sameAs field. Direct scraping of the profile (web_profile_info endpoint and page fetch) was blocked (404 / 429 responses) after 3 attempts, so IG feed photos could not be pulled; per pipeline fallback (max 2 attempts before moving to other sources), Booksy's own photo set (business photos, service photos and review photos) was used instead for the gallery.

own_site_check.domains_tried: nailzbyash.com resolves (HTTP 200) but is a GoDaddy parking/for-sale lander page (window.LANDER_SYSTEM='PW', window._trfd.push({ap:'parking'}), redirects to /lander which serves the GoDaddy generic parking app), not the business's site. nailzbyash.net, nailzbyashpompano.com and nailzbyashfl.com do not resolve. nailzbyash33.booksy.com (from task brief) is a Booksy custom subdomain that 301/307-redirects straight back to the same Booksy business page (982169_nailz-by-ash), confirmed live, so it is just a Booksy deep link, not an independent site. linktr.ee/_nailz_by_ash_ (from task brief) was opened and its links point to a DIFFERENT Instagram handle and to nailz-by-ash-2001.square.site, a Square e-commerce storefront for shipped press-on nail sets; even if related to the same person, a square.site subdomain does not count as an owned domain per pipeline rules, and its different business model (e-commerce vs. appointment salon) means it was not treated as this business's primary site.
own_site_check.conclusion: NO independently-owned website for the Pompano Beach Booksy salon. has_own_site: false. Outreach angle: 'les construi un website de muestra' / 'I built you a sample website'.

brand_vibe.description: No dedicated brand/interior photography exists (no professional studio shoot found; IG scraping was blocked). Real nail photography from Booksy (business photos, service photos and client review photos) shows vibrant, colorful nail art: tie-dye pastels, neon french tips, pink/berry 3D floral charms, gold foil flakes, chrome spirals. A warm, light, editorial base fits best, tinted toward a berry/rose accent (drawn directly from the pink and magenta tones repeated across the real photos) with a soft gold undertone nodding to the gold-foil work, to read as feminine, boutique and beauty-forward without reusing an existing palette (distinct from mizu/amani/mare/alea/pausa/browbabes/betynails).
brand_vibe.palette_name: nailzbyash (berry/rose on warm ivory with gold-foil undertone, new palette)

images_downloaded.source: Instagram feed could not be accessed (web_profile_info returned HTTP 404 on 2 curl attempts, WebFetch on the profile page returned HTTP 429); per pipeline fallback (max 2 IG attempts before moving on), Booksy's own photo set was used instead: 2 business cover photos, 8 'inspiration' gallery photos, 1 service photo, 1 logo/profile image, 18 review photos attached to verified Booksy reviews, and 1 'resource_photos' image (discarded, see owner note). All 29 files verified with `file` as valid JPEGs, all well over 15KB, none corrupt. All images used on the site were resized to a maximum width of 1000px (Pillow, LANCZOS resampling, JPEG quality 82, optimize=True).
images_downloaded.curation_note: Every downloaded photo was visually reviewed (Read/vision) one by one before selecting the 12 used on the site (1 hero + 2 studio/experience + 9 more in gallery, one image reused as hero/gallery is separate files). Excluded from the site per the visual quality gate: insp-7.jpg (bare/unfinished acrylic tips, no polish or art, not a finished result); review-02.jpg, review-05.jpg, review-10.jpg (cluttered car-interior backgrounds); review-04.jpg and review-17.jpg (Halloween/Pennywise seasonal theme, cluttered background with props, not evergreen for a demo site); review-06.jpg (pedicure spa bowl with feet soaking, no nail art visible, kept in raw only as a possible ambiance shot but not used); review-07.jpg (plain french tip, dim/flat lighting); review-12.jpg (Christmas-themed, seasonal); review-14.jpg (casual knee/couch background); review-16.jpg (barely shows the nail, mostly car interior); review-18.jpg (blurry, low sharpness). The mismatched 'resource_photos' image (a selfie of an unrelated person with a visible face tattoo, no nails shown, clearly a Booksy data mismatch) was deleted from assets/raw entirely and never considered for the owner avatar or gallery.
